title: LanguageDisciplineRegistry
description: Local/static AC-0.4 registry for the Phase-0 language-discipline allowlist. It validates GOOD/BAD changed-file fixtures and preserves the T0.4 cloud-check backlog inventory without claiming live cloud-ci authority.

_meta.source_request: Founder directive 2026-06-03: maintain modern Rust standards; use Buck2-native LLVM source-based coverage instead of Tarpaulin; preserve dual Cargo.toml + Buck2/Reindeer setup for local Cargo mutation testing; keep the language-discipline gate hyperscaler-oriented and suitable.

official_references.name: Rustc Book — Instrumentation-based Code Coverage
official_references.used_for: Records the Rust coverage standard as rustc/LLVM source-based coverage with rustc -C instrument-coverage.

official_references.name: LLVM — Source-based Code Coverage
official_references.used_for: Records llvm-profdata/llvm-cov as the source-based coverage reporting path.

official_references.name: Buck2 — Commands
official_references.used_for: Records Buck2 target execution as local/static evidence and Build ID source.

official_references.name: Buck2 — Bootstrapping
official_references.used_for: Records dual Cargo+Buck2 ergonomics and reindeer-generated BUCK graph context.

official_references.name: Reindeer
official_references.used_for: Records crate vendoring and BUCK generation from Cargo workspaces for monorepo Rust graphs.

claim_boundary.note: Fixture-backed local/static seed evidence only. This gate does not scan or mutate a live PR, post statuses, mutate branch protection, prove P0.0 green, prove Phase-0 completion, prove production readiness, or prove hyperscaler-grade readiness.

allowlist.buck2_vendored_host_prelude_python_note: Buck2 vendored host-prelude Python is toolchain substrate and not candidate-authored checked-in test sprawl. Candidate-authored checked-in Python remains blocked outside the empty allowlist.

rust_standards_record.coverage_noncanonical_surface: Tarpaulin is not the canonical coverage surface
rust_standards_record.coverage_instrumentation: rustc -C instrument-coverage with LLVM_PROFILE_FILE, llvm-profdata merge, and llvm-cov report/export under Buck2 target evidence
rust_standards_record.mutation_local_ergonomics: Dual Cargo.toml + Buck2/Reindeer setup keeps local Cargo mutation testing advisory for developer feedback while Buck2/cloud-ci captured evidence remains merge authority.
rust_standards_record.hyperscaler_orientation: Language gates are deterministic, target-addressable, allowlist-driven, non-claiming, and suitable for trusted cloud-ci/oya-ci promotion.

offender_inventory.inventory_scope: T0.4 cloud_*_check.py backlog plus current-head presence flags; current AC-0.4 branch does not add these Python files.

backlog_actions.action: Port the remaining registry/quality lane check_command rows from direct Cargo-style execution strings to concrete Buck2 targets or explicitly tracked-deferred rows with blocked rationales.

backlog_actions.action: Replace the four active shell-backed governance check rows with Rust/Buck2 gate targets or retire them behind provenance-only allowlists.
backlog_actions.validity: Valid because new coordination/gate work is Rust/Buck2-first and shell should not remain active merge authority for parallel fanout.

backlog_actions.action: Generate shared registry command projections from per-lane Buck2-owned metadata so high-concurrency lanes do not repeatedly edit registry/quality/lanes.yaml.
backlog_actions.validity: Valid because generated or pointer-thin shared surfaces reduce merge conflict probability while preserving one canonical projection.
